scientific_integrity: A self-contained proof and two distinct reproducible finite checkers are supplied. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats weight-one group maps on Q8 alone. Historical priority is qualified by incomplete full-text access and possible unindexed classifications of small finite groups. Exhaustive checking is finite; the general proof is symbolic.
title: Complete group Rota–Baxter classification on the quaternion group of order eight
